name: junior-diagnostic-curiosity
description: The assessment from the first live run, 2026-09-16. A real junior's register: lowercase, unpunctuated, self-deprecating, concrete. The engine reached moderate confidence and nineteen verified signals on it. It is the library's baseline — if this case stops behaving, the engine has drifted on the exact input it was proven against.
answers: i fixed my neighbours mower last summer because nobody else was going to and it took me all saturday. i didnt really mind, i liked figuring out what was wrong with it more than actually fixing it
the thing that makes me mad is when people get treated like theyre stupid because they cant explain something right. my mom does that at the doctor and they talk over her
i dont know. maybe something with my hands? everyone says i should go to college but nobody in my family has
i did a week at a hospital thing through school. the part i keep thinking about is when nobody knew what was wrong with someone yet. that was the only week i didnt want to leave early
money honestly. nobody in my house will actually talk about it and i dont know what any of this costs
i am good at noticing when something is off before other people do. my coach said that about me too
i just sat with her until she stopped crying, thats all i did. she said it helped but i didnt really do anything

narrative:
You keep returning to the moment before anyone knows the answer. You said the part you keep thinking about is when nobody knew what was wrong with someone yet, and you said the mower interested you because you liked figuring out what was wrong with it more than actually fixing it. That is the same interval twice, in two different settings.

You also carry something specific about people being talked over when they cannot explain themselves. You watched it happen to your mother. That is not a general wish to help people; it is a particular objection to a particular failure, and it points somewhere narrower than kindness does.

What the evidence does not yet settle is whether that belongs in medicine, in a technical trade, or somewhere adjacent to both. One week in a hospital is a real data point and it is one week. The next thing worth doing is finding a second interval like it and seeing whether it holds.
